pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/choreography/types.ts:132 A file named types.ts holds scrub-lookup algorithms (computeScrubData, findAlertAt), severity colours, lane-height constants and a module-level id counter, so the filename no longer predicts what is inside and the file has several unrelated reasons to change.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/choreography/types.ts:132 types.ts mixes layout constants, colours, a mutable id generator (line 98) and the scrub/finding lookup. The technique's tell is a container whose name no longer predicts its contents.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/choreography/index.tsx:8 The encounter simulation is a pure lib function that the editor only calls and renders.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/choreography/usePacingPaths.ts:9 Three inputs in, two SVG paths out. Bucketing and stacked-area path construction stay hidden from the timeline.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/choreography/usePacingPaths.ts:34 The loop builds two outputs (top and bottom path strings) from one pass, which is the case where sequential form is correct.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/choreography/ue5-export.ts:5 Output is a standalone C++ text block for the user to paste, not a macro or splice that resolves names in a caller's scope.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/attributes/attribute-defaults-export.ts:28 Its input is a plain constructible record (tested in attribute-defaults-export.test.ts), so there is no host-only type to mirror.

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/QuickActionsPanel.tsx:1 QuickActionsPanel.tsx, RoadmapChecklist.tsx and ContextHealthBadge.tsx in core-engine/ are one-line re-exports of modules/shared components, and grep finds no importer of them (ReviewableModuleView imports ../shared directly), so they are pure pass-through layers that give each component a second, unused address.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/QuickActionsPanel.tsx:1 Same-shape forwarding with no behaviour. RoadmapChecklist.tsx:1 and ContextHealthBadge.tsx:1 are identical shims.

src/components/modules/core-engine/PlanMatrixMap/usePlanMatrixMap.ts:7 Canvas layout and critical-path computation are pure functions in lib/implementation-planner/layout-engine. The hook only wires state.

src/components/modules/core-engine/PlanMatrixMap/usePlanMatrixMap.ts:26 Plan dispatch goes through one shared usePlanDispatch door for both the map and the plan table, so a change to dispatch lands in one place.

src/components/modules/core-engine/PlanMatrixMap/index.tsx:9 Recorded only as supporting evidence. The single hook hides pan/zoom, selection and dispatch state from the view and does not offset the shim deviation above.

pairs.registryProposal: module-depth could distinguish a compatibility re-export that still has importers (a migration seam with a removal date) from one with zero importers (dead pass-through). TypeScript trees keep the second after moving a component, and the technique's pass-through definition covers both without saying which costs more.
